meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 装上后 NanoClaw 会多出 Signal 渠道:经 signal-cli 设备链接,把你手机上的 Signal 作为主设备、助手作为副设备接入,助手用你手机号收发消息;不注册新号码,也没有 Bot API。
howto.when: 当你要给助手添加 Signal 渠道、扫码链接 Signal 账号,或排查 Signal 收发失败时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Signal 渠道,用我手机扫码链接
say.note: 会安装 signal-cli 并给出设备链接二维码

say.text: 把 Signal 账号 +15551234567 写进环境并重启服务
say.note: 写入 SIGNAL_ACCOUNT 后重启并绑定账号

say.text: 我的 Signal 用户被 not_member 挡了,帮我授权

howto.what_en: After install, NanoClaw gains a Signal channel: via a signal-cli device link, your phone's Signal hosts it as a secondary device, and the assistant sends and receives as your phone number. No new number, no bot API.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Signal channel to the assistant, link a Signal account by QR, or debug Signal send/receive failures.

say_en.text: Add a Signal channel to NanoClaw and link it with my phone
say_en.note: Installs signal-cli and opens the device-link QR

say_en.text: Store Signal account +15551234567 in env and restart the service
My Signal user is blocked with not_member — grant access
say_en.note: Grants owner role and adds to the agent group
